item.title: Free Android Emulator for Mac M1, M2, M3, M4 & M5 (and newer)
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gibo
item.description: Free Android emulator for Mac M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5 (and newer). Native ARM64, Metal graphics, keyboard and gamepad controls, optional root for developers.

item.title: Looking for a BlueStacks Alternative on Mac? Try SiliconPlay
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gibo
item.description: Looking for a BlueStacks alternative on Mac? SiliconPlay is a free, native ARM64 Android emulator for M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, and newer chips, with Metal graphics and optional root.
